name: Menhir
author: Erin Carter
description: A plain of scattered standing stones receding into luminous haze, raymarched as true 3D solids: tapered, slightly leaning prisms strewn across a jittered field while the camera dollies forward down a sinuous cleared lane, near menhirs sweeping past in parallax as far ones dissolve into a glowing horizon band, each stone edged with a thin rim of light where it meets the fog behind it.

params.label: Dolly speed
params.effect: How fast the camera walks forward through the stone field.

params.label: Fog density
params.effect: How quickly distance dissolves stones into the glowing haze - low shows many ranks, high swallows all but the nearest.

params.label: Stone spacing
params.effect: World-space gap between stones - tight crowds the path, wide leaves lonely sentinels.

params.label: Rim glow
params.effect: Strength of the thin bright edge where a stone's silhouette meets the fog behind it.
